html_source: Éamonn O'Doherty's bronze monument commemorating the Wexford pikemen of the 1798 Rebellion, installed in 1998 along the N25 between the towns of Wexford and New Ross by the Wexford County Council, in a 2015 photograph by Osioni. Source: Wikimedia Commons.
